perspective:
From RECOMMENDER’s perspective:

- SEEKER greeted me and said they were hoping to find a movie similar to *Alien* (1979) or *Halloween* (1978).
- I recommended *A Nightmare on Elm Street* (1984), and SEEKER said they loved that series as well.
- I asked if they had seen the *Friday the 13th* (1980) series. SEEKER said they watched it but weren’t as into it. I said I could understand and thought it was a little different.
- I recommended *The Thing* (1982). SEEKER said it was fun, and also said *The Blob* (1988) was fun. I said I haven’t seen *The Blob* (1988).
- I asked about *Life* (2017). SEEKER said they hadn’t seen it yet, and mentioned they liked *Happy Death Day* (2017).
- I said I tried watching *Happy Death Day* but the movie malfunctioned, so I couldn’t finish it. I suggested *10 Cloverfield Lane* (2016).
- SEEKER said *Happy Death Day* was really entertaining and probably their favorite movie of the year, and that they wanted to watch *10 Cloverfield Lane*.
- I said I was bummed I couldn’t watch *Happy Death Day*, and that *10 Cloverfield Lane* was pretty good and I thought they would like it.
- SEEKER then said they had seen *Cloverfield* (2008) and liked that.
